# Commands reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask gen-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every operation is a JSON object whose `type` is the operation name, followed by its parameters, e.g.

```json
{"type": "panel.create_rect", "width": 500, "height": 700}
```

IDs are strings such as `"panel:2"`. Lengths are in millimetres.
Errors are structured: a stable `code`, named `args` and an English `text`.

## Script steps

A script (CLI `r3d run`) is a JSON array of steps. A step is a command, a query, or one of:

- `{"type": "history.undo"}`: undo the last step.
- `{"type": "history.redo"}`: redo the last undone step.
- `{"type": "batch", "commands": [...]}`: run commands atomically as one undo step; if one fails, none is applied.

## Commands

Document edits. Every command can be undone.

### `project.rename`

Rename the project.

<details><summary>Parameters (JSON schema)</summary>

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Rename the project.",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "description": "New project name.",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "name"
  ],
  "title": "ProjectRename",
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

### `project.set_display_unit`

Choose the unit used to display lengths (storage is always mm).

<details><summary>Parameters (JSON schema)</summary>

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "DisplayUnit": {
      "description": "Unit used to *display* lengths. Storage is always millimetres.",
      "enum": [
        "mm",
        "cm",
        "in"
      ],
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Choose the unit used to display lengths (storage is always mm).",
  "properties": {
    "unit": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/DisplayUnit",
      "description": "`mm`, `cm` or `in`."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "unit"
  ],
  "title": "ProjectSetDisplayUnit",
  "type": "object"
}
```

### `panel.create_rect`

Create a rectangular panel. Returns the panel, then its 4 points (counter-clockwise from the origin), then its 4 edges.

<details><summary>Parameters (JSON schema)</summary>

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Create a rectangular panel.",
  "properties": {
    "grain_angle_deg": {
      "default": 90.0,
      "description": "Grainline angle in degrees from +X. Defaults to 90 (vertical).",
      "format": "double",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "height": {
      "description": "Height in mm (> 0).",
      "format": "double",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "name": {
      "description": "Panel name. Defaults to \"Panel N\".",
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "origin": {
      "default": [
        0.0,
        0.0
      ],
      "description": "Bottom-left corner on the board, in mm. Defaults to `[0, 0]`.",
      "items": {
        "format": "double",
        "type": "number"
      },
      "maxItems": 2,
      "minItems": 2,
      "type": "array"
    },
    "width": {
      "description": "Width in mm (> 0).",
      "format": "double",
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "width",
    "height"
  ],
  "title": "PanelCreateRect",
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

### `panel.create_polygon`

Create a panel from a closed polygon. Returns the panel, then its points, then its edges.

<details><summary>Parameters (JSON schema)</summary>

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Create a panel from a closed polygon.",
  "properties": {
    "grain_angle_deg": {
      "default": 90.0,
      "description": "Grainline angle in degrees from +X. Defaults to 90 (vertical).",
      "format": "double",
      "type": "number"
    },
    "name": {
      "description": "Panel name. Defaults to \"Panel N\".",
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "points": {
      "description": "At least 3 vertices in mm; the closing edge is implicit. Must form a\nsimple outline (no crossing or overlapping edges). Stored\ncounter-clockwise.",
      "items": {
        "items": {
          "format": "double",
          "type": "number"
        },
        "maxItems": 2,
        "minItems": 2,
        "type": "array"
      },
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "points"
  ],
  "title": "PanelCreatePolygon",
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

### `panel.rename`

Rename a panel.

<details><summary>Parameters (JSON schema)</summary>

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "PanelId": {
      "description": "Identifier of a panel, e.g. `panel:1`.",
      "pattern": "^panel:[1-9][0-9]*$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Rename a panel.",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "description": "New name.",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "panel": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/PanelId"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "panel",
    "name"
  ],
  "title": "PanelRename",
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

### `panel.delete`

Delete a panel with its points and edges. Destructive: requires "confirm": true.

**Destructive**: requires `"confirm": true`.

<details><summary>Parameters (JSON schema)</summary>

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "PanelId": {
      "description": "Identifier of a panel, e.g. `panel:1`.",
      "pattern": "^panel:[1-9][0-9]*$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Delete a panel with its points and edges.",
  "properties": {
    "confirm": {
      "default": false,
      "description": "Must be `true`: deleting is destructive (still undoable).",
      "type": "boolean"
    },
    "panel": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/PanelId"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "panel"
  ],
  "title": "PanelDelete",
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

### `point.move`

Move a contour point to a new position in mm. Curve handles attached to the point move with it. The panel may end up self-intersecting; `panel.get` reports it.

<details><summary>Parameters (JSON schema)</summary>

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "PointId": {
      "description": "Identifier of a point, e.g. `point:1`.",
      "pattern": "^point:[1-9][0-9]*$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Move a contour point.",
  "properties": {
    "point": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/PointId"
    },
    "to": {
      "description": "New position in mm.",
      "items": {
        "format": "double",
        "type": "number"
      },
      "maxItems": 2,
      "minItems": 2,
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "point",
    "to"
  ],
  "title": "PointMove",
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

### `edge.set_curve`

Make an edge a straight line or a cubic Bézier curve (absolute control points in mm).

<details><summary>Parameters (JSON schema)</summary>

```json
{
  "$defs": {
    "CurveSpec": {
      "description": "Shape to give an edge.",
      "oneOf": [
        {
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "description": "Straight segment.",
          "properties": {
            "kind": {
              "const": "line",
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "kind"
          ],
          "type": "object"
        },
        {
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "description": "Cubic Bézier; control points in absolute board coordinates (mm).",
          "properties": {
            "c1": {
              "items": {
                "format": "double",
                "type": "number"
              },
              "maxItems": 2,
              "minItems": 2,
              "type": "array"
            },
            "c2": {
              "items": {
                "format": "double",
                "type": "number"
              },
              "maxItems": 2,
              "minItems": 2,
              "type": "array"
            },
            "kind": {
              "const": "cubic",
              "type": "string"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "kind",
            "c1",
            "c2"
          ],
          "type": "object"
        }
      ]
    },
    "EdgeId": {
      "description": "Identifier of a edge, e.g. `edge:1`.",
      "pattern": "^edge:[1-9][0-9]*$",
      "type": "string"
    }
  },
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "description": "Turn an edge into a straight line or a cubic curve.",
  "properties": {
    "curve": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/CurveSpec"
    },
    "edge": {
      "$ref": "#/$defs/EdgeId"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "edge",
    "curve"
  ],
  "title": "EdgeSetCurve",
  "type": "object"
}
```

</details>

## Queries

Read-only. Lengths in mm, areas in mm², rounded to 0.001.
